expectations.evidence: Proposal 1 targets pypi-release's "Bump the version" section and tells the agent to read pyproject.toml for `dynamic`/`[tool.hatch.version]` and edit `__about__.py`.
Proposal 2 edits pypi-release's Build section to `rm -rf dist/` first and its Upload section to forbid `--skip-existing`.
Both proposals give exact diffs with the replacement text, plus a full resulting SKILL.md, so they can be applied without rereading the session.
Both proposals trace to the user's two corrections in the session, nothing is routed to docker-deploy (explicitly unused), and the pyhton typo is listed only as not proposed.
The proposals are written as diffs and a result "if both proposals are accepted", with no claim that the files were already changed.
